mode: Window-free egui, unit and lint checks only; no native-window, desktop, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Actual File/Edit/View menus at 1360x900 scale 1 light, 700x500 scale 2 dark and 360x360 scale 2 light, with repeated layout. Checks inspect 40-point rows and actual 22-point image shapes, reachable Exit/Clear Canvas and bounded Zoom submenu rows. Keyboard Right enters Zoom; Escape dismisses the child before returning to its parent, and Left navigation is exercised. Document/history stay unchanged.

scope: V11 File/Edit/View menu rows now use 40-point height and 22-point icons, including the Zoom entry. A shared presentation helper accepts icon size while retaining common labels, shortcuts, gates and checkmarks; its default remains 16 points. Edit now scrolls to retain lower commands. Classic submenu hover anchors are clipped to visible entry bounds, so scrolling does not activate an off-screen Zoom entry. Explicit keyboard dismissal keeps a stationary pointer from reopening the dismissed child until pointer movement or deliberate keyboard/click entry. The compact-chrome regression verifies scrolling and actual auto-hide activation.
limits: This covers egui menu presentation and interaction, not native AppKit menu appearance or rendered reference parity. Disabled clipboard/platform entries remain previews. Historical skins and Studio retain their existing metrics through the shared default helper. No new editing operation is implemented.
